spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/travel-concierge/issues/7. Source revision: 2026-03-04T15:40:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Add a policy search tool with citations
tasks.body:
Add a read-only Azure AI Search tool to the concierge in `src/concierge` and instructions to answer only from its results, citing the section, or say it does not know.

## Acceptance criteria
- Answers include the policy title and section of each result used.
- Questions without a matching policy get an explicit I-don't-know answer.
- Unit tests mock search and cover a hit, no hit and an injected instruction inside a result.

tasks.title: Grant the agent identity read access to the policy index
tasks.body:
Configure the search endpoint for the hosted agent and assign the agent's Entra identity Search Index Data Reader on the search service only.

## Acceptance criteria
- `azd provision --preview` shows one role assignment scoped to the search service.
- No key or connection string is added to `azure.yaml`, workflows or the image.

tasks.title: Evaluate grounded policy answers
tasks.body:
Add a golden set of at least 20 policy questions (including unanswerable ones) to `evals/` with groundedness and task adherence thresholds.

## Acceptance criteria
- The evaluation run reports groundedness and task adherence against `evals/thresholds.json`.
- Unanswerable questions are scored as correct only when the agent declines.
- The golden set contains no real traveller data.
